WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT client_id, birth_date, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
),
MaxAge AS (
    SELECT MAX(birth_date) AS oldest_birth_date
    FROM FemaleClients
),

    SELECT d.district_id, AVG(d.A11) AS avg_salary
    FROM district d
    JOIN FemaleClients fc ON d.district_id = fc.district_id
    WHERE fc.birth_date = (SELECT oldest_birth_date FROM MaxAge)
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
LowestAvgSalary AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM DistrictAvgSalary
    ORDER BY avg_salary ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN FemaleClients fc ON a.district_id = fc.district_id
WHERE fc.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM LowestAvgSalary)	----- bird -----	financial
